thread:
alex: Heads up — multiple customers reported duplicate token charges after WS reconnects lingered. Seen on canary and prod. Repro steps below.

maria: Which metric shows it? console? billing?

alex: stream_reconnects spikes, then per-route token_count jumps. Example log:
```json
{"session_id":"s-abc123","resume_id":"r-42","tokens_charged":128}
```

ops-bot: Alert: billing_anomaly high for tenant redwood-inc - 2026-03-18T10:12Z

sam: I dug into proxy logs — resume request retried to two different backend pods after lease expiry. Both accepted and billed. Looks like resume_id not deduped server-side.

nora: Telemetry issue: we don't propagate session_id into billing traces when resume goes through proxy fallback. So billing pipeline can't join two events.

jess-console: UX request — can we tag routes with 'possible-retry-dup' and link to trace? Customers are seeing cost spikes with no console explanation.

maria: Quick fix options: (1) server-side resume idempotency (lease+nonce store), (2) proxy-level sticky routing with longer lease, (3) billing pipeline tolerant dedupe using kvcache timeframe. Pros/cons?

sam: (2) is fastest but brittle for global routing. (1) is correct but needs persistent store or kcache. (3) we can attempt heuristic now.

alex: Preference: short-term do (3) + console flag; medium: (2) adjust lease TTL and sticky check; long-term implement (1) with resume_nonce persistence and amortized GC.

maria: Also need telemetry change: include resume_nonce and target_pod in stream metrics. cc @nora

nora: I'll add fields to span: resume_nonce, candidate_pod, resume_accepted boolean. Will also emit event 'resume_duplicate_detected' when seen.

jess-console: For rollout UX, let's add a tooltip on 'Unusual token variance' that explains retry-dedup edgecases and links to runbook.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260318-27 assigned to @sam, @nora. Estimated TTR 6h.

sam: I'll triage logs and add a hotfix patch to billing dedupe heuristic.

alex: Thanks. Quick notebook for reproduce posted: https://internal/redwood/notes/ws-reconnect-dupe

maria: Ping me when you have a telemetry patch so console can show the flag in the next deploy.

sam: Will post PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/proxy/pull/412

alex: tagging @eng-platform for visibility :eyes:
